[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Keloh''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed at [[Aurek Base]], where he asked a passerby to rescue a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] captured by the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Targis]].
